Statement: Store stock for each product is available from the point-of-sale and inventory systems at least every 15 minutes; its accuracy is confirmed in discovery.
Each pilot store can give space to a pickup shelf and a returns bin.
A product owner, two delivery squads and a QA lead are assigned for the full 28 weeks.
Return eligibility follows the current online policy for Beauty products (for example, unopened items only), to be confirmed with Legal and Category teams.
The pilot must avoid major sale events and the October-November festive peak.
Core DPDP Rules obligations apply from 13 May 2027 (project week 19), before pilot launch.
The BA team is a lead business analyst, a business analyst and a part-time process analyst from Retail Operations (weeks 3-11).
Store system changes can only be released in the monthly store-IT release window.
Inventory synchronisation interface from the point-of-sale system (Engineering).
Order management system changes for store-reserved orders (Engineering).
Logistics partner interface to cancel reverse pickups when items are returned in store.
Finance decision on how online and store results share CCR revenue.
Store operating procedures and training updated by Retail Operations.
